## Scope and decision

This report documents a gated reference-guided pilot. All 21 patients entered
the pilot, but the analysis stopped before full-cohort expansion because the
predeclared uncertainty gate failed. Pilot labels are diagnostic only and were
not promoted to formal provisional annotations.

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import sys

import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import Image, display

cwd = Path.cwd()
root = cwd.parent if cwd.name == "scripts" else cwd
out = root / "results/cell bin/CellBin_BroadClass_pilot_21samples"

mapping = pd.read_csv(out / "Reference18_to_BroadClass_mapping.tsv", sep="\t")
audit = pd.read_csv(out / "Reference18_input_audit.tsv", sep="\t")
gate = pd.read_csv(out / "BroadClass_pilot_gate_summary.tsv", sep="\t")
cv = pd.read_csv(out / "Pilot_reference_CV_summary.tsv", sep="\t")
sample = pd.read_csv(out / "Pilot_summary_by_sample.tsv", sep="\t")
```

The primary method was SingleR 2.12.0 using donor × unchanged-Reference18-state
pseudobulk profiles. The query pilot contained 500 G10/U20 CellBins from each
sample (10,500 total), selected deterministically across each sample's nGenes
range. See `BroadClass_method_selection.md` for the pre-execution rationale and
gate definitions.

## Input audit

```{python}
audit
```

The reference contained 57,492 cells, 18 states, 18,966 raw-count genes, and
124 donors. All 18,966 unique reference gene symbols were present in the Joint
V1 gene union. Joint V1 and the QC Parquet had identical global CellBin ID
order, and 359,329 assigned CellBins passed G10/U20.

## Pilot gate

```{python}
gate
```

Key results:

- donor-grouped Reference18 self-validation accuracy was 99.89%;
- default SingleR pruning returned zero Unknown query CellBins;
- the CellBin pilot maximum-score distribution was strongly separated from
  held-out reference profiles (median query score 0.059 versus reference
  correct-profile P5 0.363; scores are not probabilities);
- only 32.96% of forced query labels had at least two independent canonical
  markers for their predicted broad class;
- maximum score was moderately associated with nGenes/nUMI (Spearman about
  0.56), but depth was not the sole failure mechanism.

These summaries describe balanced pilot subsets, not full-sample cell-class
proportions. No spatial plausibility maps were promoted because the uncertainty
gate failed before full-cohort prediction.

## Interpretation

The four broad Reference18 classes are internally separable, but the selected
SingleR configuration does not provide a defensible abstention behavior for
the sparse FFPE CellBins. Applying an arbitrary score cutoff or filling labels
from spatial position would violate the analysis constraints. Therefore the
pilot does not establish that all 21 samples currently support interpretable,
spatially plausible, cross-sample-stable broad-class annotation.

A possible next method-development step is target-depth synthetic reference
downsampling with donor-held-out, class- and depth-stratified abstention
calibration. That recovery analysis was not run automatically.

## Output status

Formal full-cohort files (`CellBin_BroadClass_predictions.parquet`, full
sample uncertainty/marker/feasibility tables, 21 spatial prediction maps and
three-chip comparison plots) were intentionally not created. Joint V1 was not
modified.
